description: The configuration surface of the virtual-machine-scale-set chart. GENERATED from values.yaml by `./build.sh Charts` and diffed in CI — docs/plan/03 § charts/. Edit values.yaml, never this file. Members carrying `x-cybercloud-api: false` are chart or platform plumbing and are not part of the resource body.

capacity.description: How many machines the set holds: the count a new set starts at, the most the scale action may run, and what quota reserves — capacity times one machine's size and root disk. Raise it with a PUT, which reserves the difference first.

cloudInit.description: First-boot configuration every machine gets, as cloud-init reads it.

userData.description: A vault handle — path#field, optionally @version — whose value is the cloud-init user data: the #cloud-config with your users, SSH keys and packages. Resolved when the machine is rendered and written into a Secret the machine mounts; the value never enters this body. ⚠ The path must be under your own tenant's vault prefix, tenants/<tenantId>/; any other path is refused. Empty means no cloud-init at all.

image.description: The CyberCloud.Compute/images resource every machine's root disk is cloned from, by name, in this resource group. ⚠ The image must have finished importing: the set waits for it and says so.

nameOverride.description: Replace the generated object-name stem. Empty means derive it from the release name.
nameOverride.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Helm plumbing. Nothing about it belongs in a resource body.

network.description: The tenant network every machine's interface joins. Both empty means the cluster's pod network.

subnet.description: The subnet of that network the interface takes its address from, by name, or empty. ⚠ A name that is not a subnet of the network is refused by the fabric rather than by this API, and the machine never starts.

virtualNetwork.description: The CyberCloud.Network/virtualNetworks resource in this resource group, by name, or empty.

osDiskSize.description: Each machine's root disk, in Kubernetes quantity form. At least the image's own size. ⚠ Immutable.

platform.description: Resource identity injected by the reconciler. Not a tenant-facing setting.

apiVersion.description: The api-version the resource was last written at, rendered into the cybercloud.io/api-version label.
apiVersion.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

managedBy.description: Value of the cybercloud.io/managed-by label. Constant, and the selector every informer filters on.
managedBy.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

resourceGroup.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

resourceId.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

resourceType.description: Fully qualified resource type, rendered into the cybercloud.io/resource-type label.
resourceType.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

subscriptionId.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

tenantId.description: Tenant GUID, rendered into the cybercloud.io/tenant-id label.
tenantId.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

platform.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

replicas.description: The pool's replica count, or -1 for a set not yet created, which renders the capacity.
replicas.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: The scale. The reconciler reads it off the VirtualMachinePool before every render and writes back what it found, clamped to capacity; the scale action is what changes it. A tenant has no body property for it, which is why it is not generated from the schema.

size.description: Every machine's size, from the platform's sizing catalogue: s1.small is 1 vCPU and 4 GiB, and each rung doubles both. A change reaches running machines as the upgrade policy says.

upgradePolicy.description: What happens to running machines when the template changes.

maxUnavailable.description: For a Rolling upgrade, how many machines may be restarting at once.

mode.description: Manual: only machines created afterwards get the new template. OnRestart: every machine's spec is updated and each guest takes it at its next restart. Rolling: the platform restarts machines onto the new template, at most maxUnavailable at a time.
